access: Hugging Face files are gated. The publisher also links a public Google Drive alternative; its MOT folder and selected training download are accessible without login.
initial_scope: Audit only the curated short MOT clips and paired annotations before considering full-match videos.
split_policy: Use the publisher match-level split. Never split halves/cameras from one match across calibration and validation.
prior_exposure: No match files accessed in this study. Earlier exposure history not independently verified; not claimed untouched.
annotation_cautions: The ball/ track is reconstructed from annotated event anchors using constant-speed interpolation; not independent per-frame observed ball truth.
Do not input that reconstructed ball track when evaluating contact timing/possession against the events that generated it.
GSR documentation flags schema and image-dimension discrepancies. Inspect actual selected-release headers against decoded video before adapting.
BAS action timestamps do not provide exhaustive live/dead-ball or possession-interval truth.
Resolve release commit, selected file sizes/digests, clip coverage, reference quality, attribution and organizer access before any selection experiment.
alternate_release_caution: Google Drive content is not assumed identical to Hugging Face v1.2. Record file hashes and audit the actual paired MOT clip/reference.

accessed_match_content.scope: First 2048 bytes of the selected public MOT reference for schema audit; full paired clip/reference transfer started after registration.

observed_contract_warning: The selected public Drive MOT prefix starts at frame 0 and has -1 values in conf/class/visibility fields, unlike the current documented 1-based MOT GT contract. No accuracy scoring is approved from this observation.
